cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Just Say Yes
cards.instruction: Get a quick approval before anyone has time to examine the practical consequences.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Just nod and I'll accept the sofa delivery. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will it fit through the door?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. We can measure after securing the bargain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then nod before they start measuring too.

mechanism: A commands a sofa move but rapidly grants B control over measuring and placement to secure acceptance before fit is known.
confusable: Unlike mere haste, the nod must precede practical checks; unlike secure command A keeps ceding control to obtain B cooperation.
comparison: A domestic delivery with workers waiting differs from a committee booking and later money review.
seedUse: Use canonical D28-b sofa/door/arrival facts and S02-b changing the command form to keep the team cooperating.
